public_rationale: In the two months before the post, two major outlets reported trouble with OpenAI's next model. In November 2024, The Information, citing OpenAI staff, said Orion's gains over GPT-4 were far smaller than the jump from GPT-3 to GPT-4. In December 2024, the WSJ said GPT-5 was behind schedule, that training ran slower than expected, and that results did not yet justify the cost. That fits the plain reading of 'struggling to build a model worthy of the GPT-5 name'. The reports also say the model beat its predecessors, so the problem was the size of the gains, not a failure to improve.
limitations: Rests on anonymous-source news reports summarized by secondary outlets.
'Worthy of the GPT-5 name' is subjective.
